description: Land Title Settlement Department - Elamalpe, Weligapola D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620170
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and title classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership and title settlement, making it clearly a Land Gazette.
